dimensions.assessment: Covers educational institutions, school districts, and state education agencies nationwide through a representative sample study.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a study on Holocaust education efforts in States, local educational agencies, and public elementary schools and secondary schools

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a research study and report to Congress without altering curriculum mandates or school funding directly.
dimensions.evidence: prepare and submit to Congress a report on the results of the study

dimensions.assessment: No federal funding or appropriations amounts are mentioned in the source text for conducting the study.
Imposes a comprehensive research and reporting mandate on the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum covering educational requirements across all states.
dimensions.evidence: Such study shall include an examination of all States, a nationally representative sample of local educational agencies, and a representative sample of public elementary and secondary schools

dimensions.assessment: A one-time study and report due within a deadline of up to three years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: submitted not later than the earlier of... 3 years after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: Estimated financial cost or specific funding allocation for the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum to conduct the study.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum to conduct a study and submit a report to Congress examining Holocaust education efforts in all states, local educational agencies, and public schools.
